What actually sets a Bengaluru asking price

Built-up area explains most of it. Locality sets the rate — the same square foot costs 4.8 times more across the city. Together they price a listing to within 18%.

13,320 listings · 9 variables · 7 models comparedNovember 2026

A buyer does not need a model to know that area and locality matter. The useful part is how much each is worth — and where the estimate stops being trustworthy.

Source: Bengaluru house-price listings (public dataset), cleaned sample of 11,423; scikit-learn 1.9, random seed 42

Step four · configuration

A 3BHK asks 51% more than a 2BHK for 37% more floor

Price jump, same locality
+51%
Floor-area jump
+37%
Premium not explained by area
+10%

Across 156 localities with at least five listings of each configuration, the median 3BHK asks 51% more than the median 2BHK while offering 37% more built-up area.

The remaining ten points are what the configuration itself costs. A buyer choosing between the two in the same building should expect to pay for more than the extra room — and a seller marketing on floor area alone is leaving that premium unmentioned.

Measured on median asking price and median built-up area, so it is not distorted by a handful of large or small listings.

2BHK against 3BHK within the same locality group; medians per locality, then the median across localities

Step six · how far to trust it

Where it breaks

Below Rs 1.5 crore the errors are symmetric — the model is unbiased. Above it, residuals skew negative: expensive listings are consistently under-predicted. Tree ensembles cannot extrapolate beyond the price range they saw in training, and luxury listings are rare and heterogeneous. That is structural, not a tuning problem.

2,285 held-out listings, single evaluation. Average error Rs 27.6 lakh; median absolute percentage error 17.7%

Bengaluru residential prices · data science case study08
What to do with it

Use it to catch a bad quote, not to value a home

01

Flag, don't price. A quote more than 25% away from the model's estimate deserves a second look at comparables in the same locality — that is the band where two in five listings already sit.

02

Locality first, configuration second. Pricing a 3BHK on floor area alone ignores the 10% configuration premium the market charges for the extra room.

03

Stop at Rs 1.5 crore. Above that the model under-predicts by design; route luxury listings to manual comparables or a price range instead of a point estimate.

All three follow from the error distribution, not from model fit: a model that is unbiased in the middle and wrong at the top is a checking tool, not a valuation engine.

Recommendations follow from the held-out error distribution and the locality spread, not from model fit alone

Bengaluru residential prices · data science case study09
Limits

Asking prices, one snapshot, and no builder signal at all

What this cannot tell you
  • Transaction prices. Listed prices in India sit above the eventual deal; this estimates the quote, not the cheque.
  • Today's market. Availability dates cluster in 2018, so the data has no time dimension and no market cycle.
  • Builder and amenities. Society is 41% missing — the strongest quality variable a human valuer uses is simply absent.
  • Fine-grained locality. 1,305 raw spellings collapsed to 227 groups; some distinct neighbourhoods now sit in an Other bucket.
What would make it usable
  • Add listing dates and model price trend, not just price level.
  • Bring in distance to metro and tech parks, school density, floor number, building age.
  • Switch to quantile regression and report a range — closer to what a buyer needs than a point estimate.
  • Validate against registered transaction data (Kaveri/IGR) rather than portal listings.

The single largest gap is the absence of transaction prices. Everything on these pages describes the asking market — which is the right dataset for understanding structure, and the wrong one for valuing a specific flat today.

Limitations are properties of the dataset, not of the modelling approach; each is fixable with different inputs
